size_rule.description: output keeps the NAFNet input size (≤ 3968 px, from inputs.py)

retry.note: owner decision 2026-10-31: at most one retry per logical slot (two attempts), transient technical failures only; urllib makes no hidden retries

cost_bound.basis: fal NAFNet page: 'Your request will cost $0.0225 per megapixel' (research.md). Megapixels rounded up to a whole MP, plus $0.01 per call for billing rounding; total rounded up to the cent. fal reports no billed amount, so the full bound stays counted.
